identity.description: An attacker uses RDP to connect to localhost and executes a remote command to download and execute a payload. Cortex should detect the RDP connection to localhost and the subsequent execution of a malicious process.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: RDP Connection to Localhost
biocs.description: Detection of RDP connection to localhost (127.0.0.1)
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '127.0.0.1' and dst_port = 3389
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'

abiocs.name: RDP to Localhost followed by PowerShell Execution
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where an RDP connection to localhost is followed by PowerShell execution
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and action_remote_ip = '127.0.0.1' and dst_port = 3389
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| join by causality_actor_process_image_name

xql_queries.name: Detect RDP to Localhost
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '127.0.0.1' and dst_port = 3389
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect PowerShell Execution after RDP
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
